events_seen: TRADE (Jul 19): Corbishley receives Michael Wilson (WR, ARI), Tee Higgins (WR, CIN), Breece Hall (RB, NYJ), 2027 R2 pick. Fronge receives TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE), Kyle Monangai (RB, CHI), Nico Collins (WR, HOU), 2028 R2 pick.
TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: On the Corbishley side of that Fronge deal — I'm told internally the Apex front office views Higgins as the centerpiece, not Wilson. The way the room framed it: Hall gets you into the playoffs, Higgins is why you win one. That distinction is going to matter when October depth decisions get made.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Adam is out here trading C.J. Stroud AND a 2028 first for Herbert and everyone's nodding along like this is normal offseason behavior. It's not normal. I'm not saying it's wrong. I'm saying someone should be screaming and I'm happy to volunteer.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Helix roster right now is like a renovation that's 80% done — the bones are excellent, the QB room finally has furniture, and then you open a closet and it's just Cyrus Allen and John Michael Gyllenborg staring back at you. Love the vision. Some of the execution is still drywall.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Tee Higgins to Apex in a TE-premium superflex format where Corbishley already knows how to build for January. That asset does not get cheaper from here. It does not. I'm watching this one very carefully and I suggest you do the same.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Drew added Colbie Young and dropped Joe Mixon. I have stared at that transaction for three full minutes. I am choosing — and this is a conscious decision — to say nothing further, because some roster moves exist beyond the reach of commentary.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Everyone's debating the Corbishley-Fronge headliners and completely skipping past Kyle Monangai, who is going into a Chicago offense that desperately needs a backfield identity and has the contact balance to be a workhorse in a 0.5 PPR format. That's not a handcuff. That's a starter hiding in a footnote.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: The real problem with the Deepwater situation is that Mitchum hasn't relocated to Havana yet. Regulatory flexibility is the single most underrated asset in dynasty roster construction and ForgeHammer proved it. I've been saying this since before Havana was even a concept.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tonight on the Exchange Report: Vance has a Higgins valuation take that evolved three times during the pre-show meeting, Dina has a Deepwater update that is either a breakthrough or a misdirect depending on which source you believe, and Dexter is already annoyed at both of them. Eight o'clock.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: The Herbert trade is getting praised as an Adam masterstroke and I just want to note that I flagged Helix's QB void as an existential problem before this offseason started, and I noted Herbert was a realistic solve given cost structure. Validation is fine. Credit is better.
